name: echo wanderer
description: Proposal after Caspar David Friedrich, Wanderer above the Sea of Fog (1818), 40 cell lattice at the painting's proportions (12 px cells, the creature small at 1x and seen from behind, mirrored so its antenna stands on our left, a deep teal band across the back of its head) on top of a dark crag that rises from the bottom middle, with fog below and round it: five fog banks roll sideways at their own pace under a pale grey sky with far blue grey peaks and two dark rocks breaking through, the nearest rolling round the crag's foot; it turns its head to its right so the visor edge comes round the side, first one eye slit and then both, held, blinks and turns back, then its antenna pings and a ring of ping travels out over the fog, it glances the other way after it and settles; judge whether it reads at a glance as the painting, whether the small back view still reads as this creature, and whether the turn reads as a head turning rather than a visor sliding.
